NORMAL_SINUS.description: Regular rhythm, P wave before each QRS, HR 60-100 bpm.

SINUS_TACHYCARDIA.description: Regular rhythm, P wave before each QRS, HR >100 bpm.
SINUS_TACHYCARDIA.clinical_note: Common in pain, blood loss, anxiety, fever.

SINUS_BRADYCARDIA.description: Regular rhythm, P wave before each QRS, HR <60 bpm.
SINUS_BRADYCARDIA.clinical_note: Can indicate cardiac conduction disease or vagal response.

ATRIAL_FIBRILLATION.description: Irregularly irregular rhythm. No distinct P waves. Fibrillatory baseline.
ATRIAL_FIBRILLATION.clinical_note: Most common arrhythmia. Risk of stroke and thromboembolism.

SVT.description: Regular narrow-complex tachycardia, HR 150-250 bpm. P waves hidden.
SVT.clinical_note: Vagal maneuvers or adenosine may terminate SVT.

VENTRICULAR_TACHYCARDIA.description: Wide-complex regular tachycardia. Rate 120-250 bpm. No P waves.
VENTRICULAR_TACHYCARDIA.clinical_note: Life-threatening. Prepare for cardioversion or defibrillation.

VENTRICULAR_FIBRILLATION.description: Chaotic, irregular waveform. No organised rhythm. No cardiac output.

ASYSTOLE.clinical_note: NOT shockable. Confirm in 2 leads. Continue CPR. Consider reversible causes.

PEA.description: Organised electrical activity on monitor but no palpable pulse.
PEA.clinical_note: NOT shockable. Identify and treat reversible causes (5Hs and 5Ts).
